metrics.label: 10Y Real Yield Percentile
metrics.note: High real yields weigh on equity multiples.

metrics.label: Distance to 200-Day Moving Average
metrics.note: S&P 500 distance versus its 200-day moving average.

metrics.label: 12-Month Momentum
metrics.note: Trailing 12-month performance versus its rolling history.

metrics.label: 1-Year Drawdown
metrics.note: Deeper drawdowns reduce the cycle score.

metrics.label: Breadth Sample Above 200DMA
metrics.note: Share of large-cap constituents trading above their 200-day moving average.

metrics.label: VIX Complacency Score
metrics.note: Low VIX implies complacency; high VIX implies capitulation and lowers the score.

metrics.label: Fed Funds Minus CPI YoY
metrics.note: Gap between the policy rate and annual inflation.

metrics.label: 10Y-2Y Yield Curve
metrics.note: A low or inverted curve is treated as a late-cycle signal.

metrics.label: Financial Conditions Looseness
metrics.note: Loose conditions raise the score; tight conditions lower it.

metrics.label: High Yield OAS Complacency
metrics.note: Low spreads imply complacency; high spreads imply capitulation.

metrics.label: SPY vs RSP Concentration
metrics.note: Measures cap-weight dominance versus equal-weight exposure.
